def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    if k == 0:
        return [0] * n

    values = sorted(set(a))
    rank = {value: i + 1 for i, value in enumerate(values)}
    ranks = [rank[value] for value in a]
    m = len(values)
    bit = [0] * (m + 1)
    result = [0] * n

    for i, r in enumerate(ranks):
        if i > k:
            p = ranks[i - k - 1]
            while p <= m:
                bit[p] -= 1
                p += p & -p

        less_or_equal = 0
        p = r
        while p:
            less_or_equal += bit[p]
            p -= p & -p

        result[i] = min(i, k) - less_or_equal

        p = r
        while p <= m:
            bit[p] += 1
            p += p & -p

    return result
